performance.verdict: Ads are effectively off; GBP calls are the only real lead engine.

findings.text: Meta spent $18.49 total — all on 2026-09-15 — then went dark for 27 consecutive days. Zero tracked leads from $18.49 spend.
5 overdue SOW milestones: phone-match attribution (Aug 7), contact cleanup (Aug 14), dashboard live and August scoreboard trusted (Aug 31), renewal close (Jul 23) — none marked complete.
GHL shows 9 opportunities created from 146 contacts, 0 appointments booked, 0 won — intake pipeline is stalled despite GBP driving 71 calls over 28 days.
GBP actions dropped 40% week-over-week; last 3 days (Oct 10–12) logged 0 actions vs prior 3-day average of ~4.3 — organic visibility is declining.
IG reach spiked 300% week-over-week (peak 34 on Sep 15) but has collapsed to near-zero since; the BWS retargeting campaign at $12.21 is the likely cause and is now inactive.

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer; dashboard and attribution gap are blocking the client's stay/walk decision.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones are past due, the oldest from July 23; the client's renewal decision hinges on a trusted scoreboard and a live dashboard (Aug 31 deadline). Escalate to Nacer immediately and assign owners for phone-match attribution, contact cleanup, and dashboard delivery. Success is confirmed when all 5 items are marked complete in Monday and Sohib signs off on the dashboard. Target resolution by 2026-10-20.

suggestions.text: Investigate why 146 GHL contacts yield 0 appointments; likely intake or pipeline-stage configuration blocking the 71 GBP calls from converting.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP generated 71 calls and 160 actions over 28 days, but GHL shows 0 appointments booked from 9 opportunities and 146 contacts — this is an intake or CRM-stage leak, not an ads problem. Review GHL pipeline stages, call-routing from Mango Voice, and whether Lily's new intake hire is logging contacts correctly. Success is at least 3 appointments booked and visible in GHL within 7 days of the fix. Check by 2026-10-20.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions for 3 more days before any organic or content action; 0 actions Oct 10–12 may be a weekend artifact.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit zero for three consecutive days (Oct 10–12), following a 40% weekly decline. Oct 10–12 spans a weekend, so this may be a normal weekend dip rather than a structural drop. Monitor daily actions through Oct 16; if the 3-day average remains below 3 (vs the prior average of ~4.3), escalate to the SEO/GBP team for a content or listing audit. Re-check 2026-10-16.
